$comment: The forge demo bundle's size ceilings, in KiB of gzip (level 9), checked by bundle-size.mjs in the release gate (task demo:bundle-size). initial = the entry plus index.html's modulepreload and stylesheet links; total = every JS and CSS file the build emits. Rule (plan 'phase 3-4' section 1.8, reliant#3462): each ceiling is the baseline's size plus a small margin, initial about +5% and total about +56 KiB, rounded up to 10 KiB. To move a ceiling: measure main (task demo:bundle-size -- --report-only), apply the rule, update baseline and both ceilings together, and say why in the pull request.

baseline.rule: initial_gzip_kib = baseline + ~5% (519.8 -> 550); total_gzip_kib = baseline + ~56 KiB (5987.1 -> 6050). Moved on purpose: the demo now carries the app's Agents and Inbox pages as lazy chunks (dev-docs/demo-inventory.md, "Bundle size")
